help.sum:
We know how excited you are to receive your order and we will do our best to send out your items in a flash!
Order Dispatch: We aim to ship your orders as soon as possible and we generally ship out same day until 3 pm on UK business days. Please be aware that during peak periods your order may take longer to be dispatched.
Orders received after 3 pm (GMT) will be shipped the next business day.
Delivery Services: We use different couriers for different delivery destination, and we always aim to offer you the best choice of courier available.
When possible, we indicate average transit times for your specific destination. These transit times are given to us by couriers and they are average transit times. While they are generally reliable, they are not guaranteed. If your parcel is running late, our customer service team will be glad to help you liaise with the courier to investigate its whereabouts. However, we are generally unable to offer refunds on any shipping charges if your parcel has been delivered later than the stated transit time.

If you are not satisfied with your purchase you may return it to us by post using a delivery service of your choice or in store, within 14 days of receipt, and we will issue a full refund.
The item must be returned in its unworn original condition, with all paper tags and barcode labels attached.
Face masks, headbands, hair clips, hair ties, socks or earrings cannot be returned or exchanged due to hygiene reasons.
All refunds will be credited directly to your original method of payment. Delivery charges are non-refundable. Refunds are usually made by your payment provider within 7-10 working days.
